# DFG alone vs the Part 5 networks: per-character order (generated by order_report.py)

Columns: yhat = Fourier coefficient; network onset = first step with learned fraction >= 1/2 for good, from the seed-mean learned fraction (Part 5, trajectories/results); network n = smallest n of the fixed-n study whose network at step 20000 has learned fraction >= 1/2 (for good over larger n), median of 3 seeds (|S| <= 4 only); DFG n = the same for DFG's final least-squares function (per seed s0/s1/s2, and how chi_S was carried at that n: its admission class, 'linear-block', 'forced', or 'block' when only a sum block carried it); n_glob = the round-0 global-class detection size 2 ln(4 K C(30,|S|)/delta)(1 - yhat_0^2)/yhat_S^2 (degree <= 4).
